subject: Atelier working session: reschedule + sample payload checklist
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@vector-fin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Proposed Atelier session + initial sample payloads

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo today. The team is excited to move to a hands-on Atelier session where we can walk through prompt routing and run a couple of short load checks against our top 3 intent buckets.

Proposed window: Tue 2026-08-18, 10:00–11:30 ET. Goals: prompt review, routing mapping (intent -> model variant), and a 15–20 minute load run with anonymized samples.

I've attached an initial CSV with ~120 sample prompts (vector_sample_prompts.csv). These are redacted but flagged by intent column. We also included a short note on data sensitivity in the second sheet.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the session length and whether a 2nd engineer should join for the load test?
- Any particular redaction format you prefer (token-level, replace with [REDACTED], or hash)?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Alice
Alice Morgan
Product Ops, Vector Financial
alice.morgan@vector-fin.com
+1 415-555-0187

Attachments: vector_sample_prompts.csv (CSV, 120 rows)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@vector-fin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed Atelier session + initial sample payloads

Hi Alice —

Great to hear — the team enjoyed the walkthrough. Tue 08/18 at 10:00 ET is tight for a couple of our engineers; can we shift the start to 11:00 ET and run 11:00–12:30? That gives us enough time to prepare a short routing diagram and a canned quantization variant for the load test.

Responses to your asks:
- We'll plan for a 90-minute session (11:00–12:30 ET). Monica (CS lead) will own prompts/routing, and Dev (runtime engineer) will run the load test. Marissa (AM) is looped for scheduling/logistics.
- Redaction: prefer token replacement with [REDACTED] for any PII, plus a separate mapping file (hash key) if you need traceability. If you can't share hashes, a consistent placeholder is fine.

Prep checklist (we'll send an updated calendar invite once times are confirmed):
1) Clean sample set (CSV or JSONL) — flag intent column, expected output type.
2) Redaction guide (one-pager) — how you handled PII and which fields are synthetic vs. real.
3) Eval subset (20–30 prompts) we can use for quality checks before/after routing changes.
4) Network/region constraints — let us know if anything must stay in a specific region.

Could you upload the redaction guide and a 20-prompt eval set to the Drive folder? We'll pull them and do a short pre-run analysis.

If 11:00 ET works, I'll send a revised invite and include a short agenda.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@vector-fin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed Atelier session + initial sample payloads

Karthik —

11:00 ET works for us. I've uploaded two items to the Drive folder: redaction_guidelines_v1.pdf (short doc with examples) and eval_prompts_subset.jsonl (20 prompts, intent labels). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-vector-samples

Notes on the samples:
- We replaced account numbers and names with [REDACTED_ACCOUNT] and [REDACTED_NAME] respectively. We included a data_quality column where we marked borderline cases.
- There are a handful (~5) of system-level prompts that include quotas/testing instructions — those are flagged; please ignore for routing tests.

One more ask: can you confirm what load profile you plan to run (rps/burst) so our infra team can open firewall rules? If you prefer, Dev and I can jump on a quick 10-minute call pre-session to coordinate.

Thanks — Alice

Attachments: redaction_guidelines_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages), eval_prompts_subset.jsonl (JSONL, 20 items)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@vector-fin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Atelier working session: reschedule + sample payload checklist

Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the docs. Calendar invite sent for Tue 2026-08-18, 11:00–12:30 ET; link included in the invite.

Planned load profile for the short run:
- Warmup: 1 minute at 5 rps (concurrent 4–6 tokens/sec typical for your prompts)
- Burst: 3 minutes at 35 rps capped (to validate routing pressure)
- Steady: 10 minutes at 10 rps for quality-first evaluation

Firewall note: we'll originate from IP ranges 34.216.12.0/24 and 52.33.100.0/24 (US-east). If you prefer a lower burst profile, say 20 rps, let us know; we can constrain the test.

Agenda (short):
- 11:00–11:10: intros + goals (Karthik / Alice)
- 11:10–11:35: prompt review & routing diagram (Monica)
- 11:35–11:55: config walk-through + pre-run checks (Dev)
- 11:55–12:15: short burst load run (Dev)
- 12:15–12:25: quick evaluation of outputs (Monica)
- 12:25–12:30: next steps / rollouts (Marissa)

Deliverables we'll share after the session: routing diagram PDF, load-run logs (anonymized), and a short QC report with recommendations.

See you Tuesday. If anyone needs a short sync before Tuesday (10 minutes), we can do 11:00 ET Monday — Marissa will coordinate.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: eval_prompts_subset.jsonl, redaction_guidelines_v1.pdf
